title: BitwrapInviteAccept
description: The redeemer's half of a membership: the issuer (the new member) accepts one bearer invite (bitwrap-invite.v1), named by the CID of its credential. The pair (invite, accept) is a membership; a chain of pairs back to the root identity proves it. The service accepts each invite code once; until a service exists, an accept is a signed statement the member keeps and can send to the inviter.

invite.description: CID of the accepted invite's credential (proof included).

inviter.description: did:pkh of the invite's issuer, repeated so the edge reads without fetching the invite.

member.description: did:pkh of the issuer; the verifier requires it to equal the credential's issuer and to differ from inviter.

x-rules: checked with its invite: credentialSubject.invite == CID(invite credential), the invite checks (bitwrap-invite.v1), credentialSubject.inviter == the invite's issuer

x-credential.standard: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0; this schema constrains credentialSubject
x-credential.cid: CIDv1 dag-json sha2-256, base58btc, multibase z, of the whole credential (proof included)
